35/S0.subgoal: Explain the context and scope of requirement gathering within the system development life cycle and the lecture's roadmap.

35/S1.subgoal: Contrast system-centered design and user-centered design.

35/S2.subgoal: Differentiate usability requirements from other technical requirements like feasibility and code design.

35/S3.subgoal: Define usability requirements as non-functional requirements focusing on interface issues.

35/S4.subgoal: Introduce general principles and methods for gathering usability requirements, emphasizing 'knowing the user.'

35/S5.subgoal: Describe the definition, history, and primary objectives of the contextual inquiry method.

35/S6.subgoal: Explain the importance of contextual inquiry through a practical example involving a calendar application.

35/S7.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture.
